data.name: Nuwairah
data.gender_notes: Nuwairah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'nawr', meaning 'dawn'. Nuwairah refers to the light that appears before sunrise, symbolizing hope, renewal, and the beginning of a new day in Islam. The name Nuwairah carries the meaning “Light of dawn” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nuwairah usually hope their child will grow to embody light of dawn and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name filled with hope and promise, reflecting the spiritual significance of the dawn in Islamic tradition.
data.etymology: Nuwairah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light of dawn.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nuwairah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Nuwairah holds cultural significance as it alludes to the essence of dawn and the new day. In many regions of the Islamic world, the appearance of this first light of dawn marks a time for reflection, prayer, and contemplation. Furthermore, there are historical and architectural structures, such as the Na'oura Mosques, that carry this name as a sacred reminder of the dawn and its symbolic importance.
data.spiritual_significance: Heavily rooted in the spiritual dimension of Islam, Nuwairah encapsulates the sense of hope and renewal that dawn brings. This name serves as a reminder of the elaborate cycle of time and the promises that each new day holds. Embraced by many Muslims, Nuwairah provides solace and strength, inspiring believers to recognize the transformation and growth that can occur even in the most seemingly insignificant moments of life – like the Breaking of Dawn.
